bitcoin_articles.headline: Cathedra Bitcoin Receives Final Court Approval for Sphere 3D Combination
bitcoin_articles.summary: Cathedra Bitcoin Inc. has obtained the final order from the Supreme Court of British Columbia approving its statutory plan of arrangement with Sphere 3D Corp.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Hyperscale Data Bitcoin Treasury Reaches Approximately 700 Bitcoin
bitcoin_articles.summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. reported that its subsidiaries held 699.6865 Bitcoin as of May 24, 2026, with an approximate market value of $53.9 million.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Envirotech Vehicles Announces Operational Milestones in Digital Infrastructure
bitcoin_articles.summary: Envirotech Vehicles, Inc. reported the deployment of 6 megawatts of modular Bitcoin mining infrastructure and the start of NVIDIA B200 GPU hardware deliveries by its merger partner, AZIO AI.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust Executes Record $1.29 Billion Dark Pool Trade
bitcoin_articles.summary: BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) recorded its largest institutional dark pool block trade to date, involving approximately 29 million shares.

bitcoin_articles.headline: The Smarter Web Company Increases Bitcoin Holdings to 2,869 BTC
bitcoin_articles.summary: The Smarter Web Company PLC has acquired 10 additional Bitcoin for £557,865, bringing its total treasury holdings to 2,869 BTC.
